_test_case_note: TC-DAG-003 (positive): the missing third leg of execution_mode coverage -- 049/051/003 cover 'pipeline', 050 covers the negative cycle case, and this spec is the only fixture exercising 'pipeline_audit_only'. One dataflow group, all three flow kinds in ONE Lakeflow DAG (R1): zerobus ingestion of {{catalog}}.dag_003_usecase.audit_source_bus into bronze, a batch transformation over the SAME physical locator via source_inputs[0] ('audit_source_direct'), and a reconciliation_flows[0] whose execution_mode is 'pipeline_audit_only'. Fanout on that one locator is 2 (>= the source_plane 'auto' threshold) with one streaming consumer, so engine/source_plane.py registers exactly ONE materialized L0 node and both consumers bind() to it -- one physical read per update (R2). Observability is untouched and stays a job task (R3). WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM 049: reconciliation/graph_registration.py computes `needs_heal = execution_mode == _PIPELINE_EXECUTION_MODE and bool(heal_targets)` (line 349), so 'pipeline_audit_only' registers the L3 prepare and L4 compare datasets (recon__<id>__<target>__classified/__metrics/__mismatch, plus the dq_config expectations attached to the one-row __metrics dataset) and then returns at the `if not needs_heal` guard (line 534) WITHOUT registering the L5 pulse/append_flow/foreach_batch_sink heal lane. append_target_table is therefore deliberately PRESENT here and is NOT rejected: spec_validator.py::_validate_reconciliation_target_configs REQUIRES it for any comparison_direction of 'source_to_target'/'both' with no exemption for audit-only mode (line 1396), and _wants_heal (graph_registration.py line 237) still reads it -- it is what the STANDALONE 05_reconciliation_engine.py job task will use to heal, which is exactly the point of audit-only: comparison in-pipeline, healing left in job mode. That is the documented fallback for a source that cannot be read as an append-only stream or a runtime without dlt.foreach_batch_sink. Mode-conditional rules still bite in audit-only mode because it is in _RECONCILIATION_PIPELINE_MODES: dataflow_group_id is mandatory (V-CYC-6), source_config.table must be a target THIS group produces (V-CYC-1) via an append-only producer (V-CYC-7 -- hence APPEND into a streaming_table, never a merge CDC strategy or a TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD materialized_view), read_mode 'streaming' is rejected on both sides, task_run_id_column is rejected on both sides, and publish_schema/dq_config are permitted (they would be rejected under execution_mode 'job'). append_target_table points at {{catalog}}.dag_003_remediation.audit_heal_landing -- neither an in-spec target (V-CYC-2), nor this group's raw ingestion source (V-CYC-3), nor either compared side (V-CYC-5). See flowx_testing/TESTING_PLAN.md and docs/07_reconciliation_engine.md.

ingestion_flows.source_description: TC-DAG-003: zerobus ingestion of {{catalog}}.dag_003_usecase.audit_source_bus into an APPEND streaming_table -- an append-only producer, which is what V-CYC-7 requires of the dataset reconciliation_flows[0] reads as its source in a pipeline execution_mode. transformation_flows[0] reads the SAME physical locator directly, so the read-once source plane serves both from one scan per update.

transformation_flows.source_description: TC-DAG-003: reads {{catalog}}.dag_003_usecase.audit_source_bus directly as a batch transformation input -- the SAME external locator ingestion_flows[0] streams via zerobus -- so the audit-only recon case still proves the cross-flow-kind source-plane dedup, not merely the recon registration path.
